text: {"memo": "AMD delivered a robust FY2024 performance, with revenue climbing to $25.79\u202fbillion from $22.68\u202fbillion in FY2023, representing a double‑digit expansion. Net income more than doubled to $1.64\u202fbillion versus $0.85\u202fbillion a year earlier, while operating income surged to $1.90\u202fbillion from $0.40\u202fbillion, highlighting strong operating leverage. Diluted EPS rose to $1.00 per share in FY2024 from $0.53 in FY2023. Operating cash flow nearly doubled to $3.04\u202fbillion, up from $1.67\u202fbillion, underscoring improved cash generation. FY2024 net margin reached roughly 6\u202fpercent and operating margin about 7\u202fpercent, reflecting disciplined cost control. The company\u2019s FY2023 baseline shows a solid foundation, and the FY2024 results indicate accelerating profitability and cash flow conversion. Overall, AMD\u2019s fiscal trajectory demonstrates healthy growth, margin expansion, and robust cash generation, positioning the stock for continued upside."}
